classification.rationale: Connecting rods for diesel engines used in heavy trucks are parts of heading 8408 engines, classified in heading 8409. The statistical line names connecting rods for engines installed in 8704 vehicles. I83991 (in force) supports classifying engine parts in 8409.99.92 for a marine engine part, which confirms the heading but not the vehicle line.
